linePathForm.manageLinePathsDescription: Select a line and draw its path. Switch to Tabu area mode to mark excluded holds. Switch between lines and save them all at once.
linePathForm.helpDetailsMobile: Drag anchors to adjust them — they snap to anchors of other lines. Long-press an anchor to delete it. Tap a segment of the active line to insert an anchor. In Tabu mode, tap at least three points and finish the area (or tap the first point). Tabu anchors do not snap, and the area cannot be closed if edges cross. Checkboxes next to the image assign areas to the selected line — switch the line above to reuse an area on another line.
linePathForm.helpDetailsDesktop: Drag anchors to adjust them — they snap to anchors of other lines. Right-click an anchor to delete it. Click a segment of the active line to insert an anchor. In Tabu mode, click at least three points and finish the area (or click the first point). Tabu anchors do not snap, and the area cannot be closed if edges cross. Checkboxes next to the image assign areas to the selected line — switch the line above to reuse an area on another line.
linePathForm.noTabuAreasYet: No tabu areas yet. Draw one on the image.
linePathForm.tabuRequiresLinePath: Draw the line on the image first to assign tabu areas.
linePathForm.drawALineWithAtLeastTwoAnch: Draw a line with at least two anchor points.
